# Security policy / 安全策略

## Supported versions / 支持的版本

Security fixes go into the latest release, including pre-releases on the beta channel. Please update before reporting.

安全修复只进入最新版本（含测试版通道的预发布版）。报告前请先更新到最新版。

## Reporting a vulnerability / 报告漏洞

Please **do not** open a public issue. Report privately through [GitHub's private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/Yukk1No/kinshoko/security/advisories/new) and include the affected version, the steps to reproduce, and the impact you expect.

请**不要**公开提交 issue。请通过 [GitHub 私密漏洞报告](https://github.com/Yukk1No/kinshoko/security/advisories/new)提交，写明受影响的版本、复现步骤和你预计的影响。

Examples of what counts / 适用的范围，例如：

- Bypassing update signature verification. / 绕过更新包的签名校验。
- Kinshoko modifying or deleting original images, or writing outside the locations you chose. / Kinshoko 改动或删除原图，或写到你没有选择的位置。
- Safe mode revealing hidden content. / 安全模式泄露了被隐藏的内容。
- Diagnostics or logs exposing file names, paths or images. / 诊断信息或日志暴露了文件名、路径或图片。

Kinshoko is maintained by one person in their spare time, so replies may take a few days.

Kinshoko 由一人在业余时间维护，回复可能需要几天。
